'''Recruitment''' was a subdivision of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Media Division]]. It was responsible for sourcing new employees for the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. Due to the work done by [[Public Relations]] and [[Entertainment]], Recruitment never had problems meeting its quota. Recruitment maintained offices throughout the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
